verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp, with pages on what it is, how to connect it as a custom connection, which tools it supports, and security practices such as revocable access. A probe confirms the official MCP docs exist. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent, and a complete documented tool catalog (including which write actions MCP exposes) beyond example natural-language queries.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Set the MCP server URL to `https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp`.
Connect your AI tools to Mercury accounts using the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard that lets AI assistants interact with your accounts, transactions, recipients, cards and more.
Automate your financial operations with a full banking API, terminal-native CLI, and AI-ready MCP server.
The Mercury MCP will accurately and quickly return your Mercury data.
The ability to revoke access at any time from your Mercury dashboard
